faq: A barndominium is a building that combines living space with a shop, garage, or storage under one roof. Many are built on a steel frame because it offers wide open space and strong, durable construction.
What does Brooks Steel Buildings supply for a barndominium?

We supply the engineered steel building package: the frame, roof and wall panels, and trim, with options such as insulation, canopies, and commercial walk doors (man doors). Foundation, interior finishing, utilities, and living space are by others.
Do you supply overhead doors and windows?
No. We design the building and its openings for the overhead doors and windows you choose, and they are installed by others. We supply commercial walk doors (man doors).
Yes. We supply insulation. Tell us how you will use the space and we will include the right options in your quote.
Can I live in a steel building?
Many people do. Residential use comes with building department and lender requirements that vary by county, so check with them early and share your plans with us.
Do I need a permit for a barndominium?
Yes, in most places. Requirements vary by county or city. Check with your local building department. Your building is engineered for local codes, with plans prepared for permitting.
What size barndominium building do I need?
Start with the living space you want, then add the shop, garage, or storage space. Tell us your plans and we will help you choose a width, length, and eave height.
How long does it take to get a barndominium building?
Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks. Timelines can vary with project size, options, and demand.
